summary: Frontend verification of InkPicker integration in LF/DP calculators and PDF support in Ink Estimator. All primary flows pass with expected values.

issues: Ink cost row is labeled generically as 'UV print $30.00' with no machine name. LF shows explicit 'Ink · <machine> · <ml> ml · $cost' line, DP does not include the selected machine name in the breakdown. Retail is correct ($232.80 w/ LEJ-640FT @100%), but the review request mentioned an 'Ink (<machine>)' row for DP — the machine name is absent. Minor UX inconsistency between LF and DP.

verification_results.LF_Mimaki_50pct: Retail $278.40, ink line 'Ink · Mimaki UCJV300-160 · 160 ml' = $40.00 — MATCHES EXPECTED
verification_results.DP_LEJ640FT_100pct: Retail $232.80, UV print $30.00 — matches expected retail; ink cost flowing into total
verification_results.InkEstimator_PDF_label: Label reads 'Upload PDF / PNG / JPG / TIFF'; accept='application/pdf,image/*' — PASS
verification_results.non_admin_gating_cliente1: InkPicker not rendered on /large-format nor /direct-print for cliente1@test.com (isAdmin gate works). Pages remained reachable but picker hidden as designed.

action_items: OPTIONAL: For DP, consider showing 'Ink (<machine>) · <ml> ml' as its own CostRow (like LF) so admins can see how much of the print_cost is ink vs base print. Currently the machine name is absent from the DP breakdown.
critical_code_review_comments: InkPicker uses value='none' for the sentinel but consumers compare with `machineId !== 'none'`. Works, but a magic string; consider constant.
InkPicker fetches /machines silently swallows errors (.catch(() => {})) — no user feedback if admin has network issue.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 10 verified InkPicker in LF+DP and PDF label in Ink Estimator. Numbers match backend curl expectations exactly. Only minor observation: DP breakdown doesn't show machine name in ink row (LF does).
